findings.text: §53's Why says "Promotion accepted the record", but at the base revision promotion refuses a gate command whose first token names no startable program: `_require_executable_gate_command` (reckon/crew/promotion_gate.py:647) called from promotion.py:1469 raises for `-m pytest tests/test_a.py`, and `crew merge` reaches the same guard with `require_gate_check=True` (merge.py:193); a direct probe at 599c1687ca refuses both the option-led command and returns the "names no executable" refusal

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — the one anchor §53 introduces, `crew declare-gate`, resolves to a real command (reckon/crew_run_commands.py:4596), and the section hrefs resolve with extensionless targets read as `<path>.html`.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §53's negative control ("at the base revision the first case is accepted at delivery") is falsifiable and covers the one case that is false at base; the accepted-program and declared-gate cases are regression cases that hold at base by design, so they need no control.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §53 names no session scratchpad or node-local temporary path; its gate and base arm are the plan's standing run-directory artefacts, and the unit's added comments are on the plan itself.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or changelog prose reach the unit; §53 describes the mechanism (a command whose first token names no startable program) rather than the incident that motivated it, beyond the incident sentence a Why paragraph is for.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §53's Why states that "promotion accepted the record", but at the base revision (599c1687ca) promotion refuses exactly that text, so the section's stated mechanism is not what the code does and a node built from it may add a second copy of a guard that already fires rather than close the path the incident actually took.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §53 carries one deliverable, a delivery-time refusal of a gate command that names no program; its three cases all measure that one refusal and its remedy.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — `plan-section-depends-on` (§10's waits) was edited in this unit to add s48, s49 and s50 but still omits s51, s52 and s53, although §10's deliverable is a day of live landings taken after the other sections land, so a day measured now measures behaviour those three sections change.
